environment.description: Service runs behind an internal NLB (net/template-svc-nlb/a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8) in VPC vpc-0fedcba987654321. The NLB target group health check path is /health. Network access is controlled via VPC security group sg-0aabbccddeeff0011 attached to the NLB ENIs, which permits inbound TCP/8080 only from source CIDR prefixes listed in a managed prefix list (pl-0123456789abcdef0). The prefix list contains exactly three entries: 10.200.0.0/16 (internal microservices subnet), 172.16.48.0/20 (CI/CD runner subnet), and 192.168.100.0/24 (SRE bastion hosts). The NLB has no public-facing listener; its scheme is 'internal'. The VPC has no internet gateway route for the subnet hosting the NLB (subnet-0aaa1111bbbb2222c, route table rtb-0fff3333eeee4444d routes only 10.0.0.0/8 and 172.16.0.0/12 via local and transit gateway). DNS resolution for the service endpoint (template-svc.internal.corp.example.com) is served by Route53 private hosted zone (Z0123456789ABCDEFGHIJ) associated only with VPCs in the same account.
